title: 第1章 美女老师
content_zh:
一声悲愤欲绝的嘶吼，突然在皖中市一中初三（二）班的教室里响起，正在认真听课的学生们被这声音吓了一跳，纷纷扭头转身，向着声音响起处看去。

发出嘶吼声的，是坐在教室最后一排北侧角落里的叶寒。

叶寒，性格孤僻内向，学习吊儿郎当，平时衣着邋遢，上课总是睡觉，是在校长那里都挂了名的混混学生，班主任夏紫萱多次对他进行劝导教育，他却一直死不悔改，无奈之下，夏紫萱只好对他置之不理。

就在刚才，叶寒还趴在课桌上呼呼睡着大觉，谁也不知道他发了什么神经，突然扯开嗓门大吼一声，同学们看向他时，他已经从座位上站了起来，胸膛急剧起伏着，满脸愤懑不甘之色。

“叶寒，你鬼叫什么？谁让你站起来的？给我坐下去！”

今天这节课，是初三（二）班班主任夏紫萱带的，她正在讲台上兴致勃勃的授课，却被叶寒的咆哮声给打断，心中不由又惊又怒，纤纤玉手向着叶寒一指，美眸含威，俏脸生寒，杀气腾腾。

夏紫萱在少女时期就是有名的才女，由于成绩优异，十六岁时被全国重点大学燕京大学破格录取，毕业后她本可以留在燕京市，找到一份让人羡慕的工作，谁知却出人意料的回到了家乡皖中市，做起了一名普普通通的中学教师。

夏紫萱今年二十二岁，长发披肩，肌肤白皙，容貌绝美，身材凸凹有致，被同行们誉为本市“第一美女教师”，身边追求者众多，但她强势的性格、清冷的气质以及对任何男人都是敬而远之态度，却让不少追求者望而却步。

身为班主任，夏紫萱在班里拥有着至高无上的权威，学生们几乎人人都对她心存敬畏，可是现在，叶寒这个成绩倒数、性格怯懦、上课喜欢睡觉、简直一无是处的家伙，居然敢咆哮课堂，这无异于是在挑战她的权威，所以夏紫萱在错愕之余，也有些愤怒。

“你不坐下是吧？那好，你给我站到教室外面去！”

平时夏紫萱呆要一声令下，叶寒准会耷拉着脑袋，灰溜溜的站出去，可今天他仿佛是被吓傻了，对于夏紫萱的命令无动于衷，木头桩子似的站在那里，脸上神色变幻不停。

夏紫萱恼恨叶寒的不听话、同学们惊诧叶寒的胆子大，可是他们谁也没有想到，此时此刻的叶寒，心里却掀起了滔天的波澜。

渡劫失败，形神俱毁，实在是不甘心啊！唉，我这回儿应该已经魂归九幽了吧？嗯，身边好多穿着奇形怪状衣服的小鬼，这里肯定是九幽地府了……这些小鬼看起来都很年轻，不知为何会早早逝去，实在可惜……不对！这里若是九幽地府，应该充斥着阴熬之气和腐朽尸气才对，为什么我感觉到的却是旺盛的阳气和活人的生气呢？这……这到底是怎么回事？

叶寒忽然想到了转世轮回、灵魂夺舍这一说，难道现在的自己就是占据了别人身体，以这种方式重生了？

为了证实自己还活着，叶寒伸出右手，在自己的左手背上用力拧了一把，虽然疼的泪水长流，但他却难掩心中狂喜，放声大笑起来：“活着！哈哈……我真的还活着！”

他站在那里又笑又叫，状若癫狂，班里数十名同学看的目瞪口呆，有些同学还以为叶这是在故意和班主任夏紫萱作对，一个个挤眉弄眼，嘻嘻窃笑。

“咆哮课堂……目无师长……叶寒，反了你了！”夏紫萱俏脸如罩冰霜，大步走到叶寒身旁，扬起手中的课本，朝着他脑门上“啪”的拍打了一下，怒道：“你给我出去！站出去！”

夏紫萱咬牙切齿的把“站出去”两个字重复了几遍，直到气的快要暴走时，叶寒这才从浑噩状态中回过神来，意识到眼前这个穿着怪异、气质冷艳的女子是在冲着自己发脾气呢。

摸了摸被打的脑门，叶寒脸上流露出让夏紫萱恨得牙根发痒的茫然无辜表情，他双手抱拳，问道：“敢问这位姑娘，在下与你素不相识，也未曾招惹于你，你……你为何要打骂在下？”

他这文绉绉的话一出口，立即逗得全班学生轰然大笑，夏紫萱气的浑身发抖，忍不住扬起课本在他脑门上又来了一下，恨恨道：“叶寒，你少跟我装神弄鬼！出去！”

虽然夏紫萱这两下打的并不疼，但叶寒的前世是修真大派“仙医门”首席大弟子，被一介女流之辈这样欺辱，实在太不像话，若非他是个怜香惜玉的人，打自己的又是个难得一见的美人儿，他早就愤而还手了。

“姑娘，你身为女子，怎能动辄对人施以暴力？倘若你这‘河东狮’的名声传扬出去，今后还有谁家男子敢娶你？你又怎生嫁得出去？”叶寒看着一脸怒色的夏紫萱，一本正经的道。

同学们闻言，又是一阵轰笑，谁也没有想到这个平时胆小懦弱、孤僻内向的家伙今天居然幽默了一把，公然调戏起美女班主任，实在是胆子够肥。

“叶寒，给你最后一次机会！站不站出去？”

夏紫萱快要气昏了头，饱满高耸的酥胸随着急促的呼吸上下起伏，美目瞪视着叶寒，如果眼光能杀人的话，叶寒相信自己早就被大卸八块了。

叶寒天生是个乐天派，又是个随遇而安的人，经历了刚刚清醒时那一刻的迷茫困惑后，很快就平静下来，心想既来之则安之，既然老天赐予了自己一次重生的机会，那就要加倍珍惜，好好的在这个世界里活下去。

从眼前所处的环境来看，叶寒意识到这应该是个传道授业的场所，眼前这个横眉怒目的冷艳年轻女子，似乎是个师长的身份，受到前世尊师重道的观念影响，叶寒无意和夏紫萱对抗下去，于是歉然一笑，道：“方才在下咆哮课堂、无视师长，确实是不该，在下这里向姑娘赔罪了。若能平息姑娘的胸中怒火，在下站出去又有何妨？”

他说完这句话后，冲着夏紫萱抱拳深深一揖，然后离开座位，大步走到教室门外站定。

这一刻的叶寒，原本有些佝偻的身形竟挺的有如标枪般笔直，原本慵懒萎靡的神态被抖擞的精神代替，原本黯淡无光的眼睛也变的格外清亮有神……包括夏紫萱在内的师生们见到他这副模样，心里都升起一种极其怪异的感觉，这家伙怎么一觉醒来，像是脱胎换骨、变了个人似的？

夏紫萱虽然给人的感觉严肃刻板，但心胸并不狭窄，既然叶寒已经给她道了歉，她也就不再继续追究，深深看了叶寒一眼后，按捺住了心中的那份疑惑和好奇，站到讲台上继续讲课。
content_en:
A scream of grief and anger suddenly sounded in the classroom of Class 3 (2) of the No. 1 Middle School in Wanzhong City. The students who were listening carefully were startled by the sound, and they all turned around and looked towards the place where the sound came from.

The one who roared was Ye Han, who was sitting in the north corner of the last row of the classroom.

Ye Han is withdrawn and introverted. He studies casually, is slovenly dressed, and always sleeps in class. He is a gangster student who is even known to the principal. His class teacher Xia Zixuan has persuaded and educated him many times, but he has never repented. In desperation, Xia Zixuan had to ignore him.

Just a moment ago, Ye Han was lying on the desk, soundly asleep. No one knew what happened to him, and he suddenly shouted at the top of his voice. When the students looked at him, he had already stood up from his seat, his chest heaving rapidly, and his face was full of resentment and unwillingness.

"Ye Han, what's your name? Who told you to stand up? Sit down!"

Today's class was taught by Xia Zixuan, the head teacher of the third grade (second grade) class. She was teaching enthusiastically on the podium, but was interrupted by Ye Han's roar. She couldn't help but feel shocked and angry. She pointed at Ye Han with her slender hand, her beautiful eyes were full of power, her pretty face was cold and murderous.

Xia Zixuan was a famous and talented girl when she was a girl. Due to her excellent grades, she was admitted to Yanjing University, a key national university, at the age of sixteen. After graduation, she could have stayed in Yanjing City and found an enviable job, but unexpectedly she returned to her hometown of Wanzhong City and became an ordinary middle school teacher.

Xia Zixuan is twenty-two years old this year. She has long hair, fair skin, beautiful appearance, and a curvy figure. She is praised by her peers as the "most beautiful teacher" in the city. She has many suitors around her, but her strong personality, cold temperament, and attitude of staying away from any man have kept many suitors away.

As the class teacher, Xia Zixuan has supreme authority in the class, and almost everyone among the students is in awe of her. But now, Ye Han, a guy with the lowest grades, a cowardly personality, a tendency to sleep in class, and a good-for-nothing guy, dares to yell at the class. This is tantamount to challenging her authority, so Xia Zixuan is shocked, but also a little angry.

"You're not going to sit down, are you? Well, stand outside the classroom!"

Normally, when Xia Zixuan would give an order, Ye Han would hang his head and stand out dejectedly, but today he seemed to be frightened and was indifferent to Xia Zixuan's order. He stood there like a wooden pile, with an ever-changing expression on his face.

Xia Zixuan was angry at Ye Han's disobedience, and her classmates were surprised by Ye Han's courage, but none of them expected that at this moment, Ye Han would feel a huge wave of emotions in his heart.

After failing to overcome the catastrophe, both body and soul were destroyed. I was really unwilling to accept it!Alas, I should have returned to Jiuyou this time, right?Well, there are many little ghosts wearing strange clothes around us. This must be the Jiuyou Underworld... These little ghosts all look young, and for some reason they died early. It's a pity... No!If this place were the Jiuyou Underworld, it should be filled with the energy of yin and decay and the energy of decaying corpses. Why do I feel strong Yang energy and the vitality of living people?This...what is going on?

Ye Han suddenly thought of the theory of reincarnation and soul seizing. Could it be that he was occupying someone else's body and was reborn in this way?

In order to confirm that he was still alive, Ye Han stretched out his right hand and pinched the back of his left hand. Although tears flowed from the pain, he could not hide the ecstasy in his heart and laughed loudly: "Alive! Haha... I am really alive!"

He stood there laughing and shouting, as if he was crazy. Dozens of students in the class looked on dumbfounded. Some students thought that Ye was deliberately going against the class teacher Xia Zixuan, and they all winked and chuckled.

"Roaring class...no teacher...Ye Han, I turned against you!" Xia Zixuan's pretty face was covered with ice. She strode up to Ye Han, raised the textbook in her hand, slapped him on the head, and said angrily: "Get out! Stand out!"

Xia Zixuan gritted her teeth and repeated the word "stand out" several times, until she was about to run away in anger. Only then did Ye Han come back to his senses from his hazy state and realized that the strangely dressed and cold-tempered woman in front of him was angry at him.

Touching the beaten forehead, Ye Han showed a blank and innocent expression on his face that made Xia Zixuan's teeth itch with hatred. He clasped his fists and asked, "May I ask this girl, I have never met you, and I have never provoked you, you... why do you beat me and scold me?"

As soon as his literate words came out, the whole class burst into laughter. Xia Zixuan was so angry that she was shaking all over. She couldn't help but raise the textbook and hit him on the forehead again, and said bitterly: "Ye Han, stop pretending to be a fool with me! Get out!"

Although Xia Zixuan's two blows were not painful, Ye Han's previous life was the chief disciple of the "Immortal Medicine Sect" of the great cultivation sect. It was really outrageous to be bullied by a female class like this. If he hadn't been a compassionate person and the one who hit him was a rare beauty, he would have fought back angrily.

"Girl, as a woman, how can you frequently inflict violence on others? If your reputation as the 'Hedong Lion' spreads, who else will dare to marry you in the future? How can you ever get married?" Ye Han looked at Xia Zixuan, who looked angry, and said seriously.

When the students heard this, they burst into laughter again. No one expected that this usually timid, withdrawn and introverted guy would actually have a sense of humor today and openly tease the beautiful class teacher. He was really courageous.

"Ye Han, give you one last chance! Will you stand up?"

Xia Zixuan was about to faint with anger. Her plump and tall breasts rose and fell with her rapid breathing. She stared at Ye Han with her beautiful eyes. If eyes could kill, Ye Han believed that he would have been torn into pieces.

Ye Han was born to be an optimist and a happy-go-lucky person. After experiencing the confusion and confusion at the moment when he just woke up, he quickly calmed down and thought that he would take care of himself. Since God had given him a chance to be reborn, he should cherish it even more and live well in this world.

Judging from the environment in front of him, Ye Han realized that this should be a place for preaching and teaching. The cold and charming young woman in front of him seemed to be a teacher. Influenced by the concept of respecting teachers and respecting morality in the previous life, Ye Han had no intention of confronting Xia Zixuan, so he smiled apologetically and said: "I just yelled in class and ignored the teacher. It was really wrong. I apologize to the girl here. If I can calm the anger in the girl's chest, what's the harm in standing out?"

After he finished saying this, he cupped his fists and gave Xia Zixuan a deep bow, then left his seat and strode to stand outside the classroom door.

At this moment, Ye Han's stooped figure was as straight as a javelin. His original lazy and sluggish demeanor was replaced by a vigorous spirit, and his dull eyes became exceptionally clear and lively... Teachers and students including Xia Zixuan felt an extremely strange feeling in their hearts when they saw his appearance. Why did this guy wake up as if he was a completely different person?

Although Xia Zixuan came across as serious and rigid, she was not narrow-minded. Now that Ye Han had apologized to her, she stopped pursuing it. After taking a deep look at Ye Han, she suppressed the doubts and curiosity in her heart and stood on the podium to continue her lecture.
